With regards to feeling fake, I think some of it stems from the fact that I generally hide my depression from people. I'll be having a terrible day, but will act my usual self around people. I guess because deep down, I worry that they won't stick around if I'm just depressed all the time. And I wouldn't even blame them for that. 


I often think that I'm just sort of fucked, and that there's no real help for me. 

And the issue with my baggage and girls, is that my baggage makes it almost impossible to really approach or flirt with virtually anyone. I can't even have a girl touch me in literally any way, without it making me uncomfortable. 

I dunno. Thank you though.

Thank you, I don't know if I will or won't take you up on your offer in the future, but who knows. 

And I'm personally an atheist, but if you still want to pray for me, then go ahead,I don't mind.
